_readme: Human-authored corrections to the pricing rate card.
The card is parsed from 00_Guide_Pricing in the knowledge base. When that
parse gets a rate wrong or misses one, fix it HERE once — it then applies
to every future proposal instead of being re-done by hand each time.
Entries are merged by rateId: a matching rateId replaces the parsed rate,
a new rateId adds one. Everything else comes from the guide.
unit: hour | fixed | percent | monthly | annual | unknown
Use amountLow/amountHigh for a band, amount for a single figure.
